subject: Emotions
title: The Joy Set Point
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Joy Set Point.

hook.text: Twin studies show that about 50% of your happiness level is genetic. You're born with a joy thermostat.

buildup.text: Sonja Lyubomirsky's model: 50% genetics, 10% circumstances, 40% intentional activities. You control more than you think.

discovery.text: The 40% isn't passive. It requires deliberate habits: social connection, gratitude, purpose, and physical movement.

twist.text: Epigenetics shows that experiences can modify gene expression. Your set point isn't truly fixed—it can shift over years.

climax.text: You can't choose your baseline, but you can choose your habits. And habits, over time, become your new baseline.

punchline.text: You inherit the thermostat. You choose the setting.

quiz.question: According to Lyubomirsky, what percentage of happiness comes from intentional activities?
